upstream.description: Desktop AI Assistant powered by GPT-5, GPT-4, o1, o3, Gemini, Claude, Ollama, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Grok, Bielik, chat, vision, voice, RAG, image and video generation, agents, tools, MCP, plugins, speech synthesis and recognition, web search, memory, presets, assistants,and more. Linux, Windows, Mac

classification.analysis: PyGPT is an all-in-one desktop AI assistant for Linux, Windows and Mac supporting GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, and local Ollama models through a single Python/PySide UI. It offers 11 operating modes (chat, RAG chat-with-files via LlamaIndex, agents, vision, image/video generation, autonomous mode), plugin-based tool execution (filesystem, code interpreter, web search, MCP), speech synthesis/recognition, and long-term context memory. A mature, actively maintained open-source project (since 2023, distributed via PyPI/Snap/Microsoft Store) for power users wanting a local, provider-agnostic ChatGPT-like assistant.

use_cases.title: Run a provider-agnostic desktop AI assistant with your own API keys
Chat with local files via RAG and LlamaIndex
Automate tasks with plugin-based tool execution and MCP
Use voice input/output with an AI assistant offline-friendly setup
